attempted_claim: For X_lambda={w^2=g_{6,lambda}(x_0,x_1,x_2,x_3)} in P(1,1,1,1,3) as in (0.2) of Massarenti arXiv:2608.22333 Theorem C, and U_6 the nonempty Zariski-open neighbourhood of 2 over which X_lambda is a terminal factorial Fano threefold with Cl=Pic=Z[O(1)], rho=1, birational to a degree-one del Pezzo fibration and dominated by P^3 by a degree-9 map (X_2 has basket cD_4+2cA_3+13cA_1): decide unconditionally whether X_2, and hence general X_lambda for lambda in U_6, is K-polystable (equivalently admits a weak Kahler-Einstein metric), by proving delta(X_lambda)>=1 (>1 for K-stability) via an explicit Abban-Zhuang admissible flag or by exhibiting a prime divisor/valuation computing delta<1 that K-destabilises it.
decisive_failure: The investigation could not close either horn of the required dichotomy: the explicitly constructed cD4 weighted blowup is K-positive (beta=+3/4) rather than destabilising, hyperplane alpha tests remain inconclusive, and the full Abban-Zhuang programme needs rigorous local delta bounds at all 16 cDV germs on singular surfaces which exceeded the bounded session. No destabilising valuation was found and no independently valuable emergent increment emerged, so no stability claim is made.
